answer: All our premium solar panels come with a 25-year manufacturer product and power output warranty, guaranteeing at least 85–92% of original power production after 25 years. Inverters include 10–25 year coverage, and battery units include 10–15 year warranties.

Solar panels still generate electricity on cloudy or overcast days using diffuse sunlight (typically 10% to 25% of peak capacity). During nighttime, your home seamlessly pulls power from your solar battery storage or the local utility grid.

Under the Federal Solar Investment Tax Credit (ITC), homeowners who purchase their system are eligible for a 30% tax credit on the total gross installation cost, including solar panels, battery storage, permitting, and labor.

Most residential solar systems pay for themselves within 5.5 to 7.5 years through utility bill elimination. Over a 25-year system lifespan, the average homeowner saves between $35,000 and $65,000 on electric bills.

Solar panels have no moving parts and require virtually zero maintenance. Rain naturally washes away dust. SolarFlow provides 24/7 proactive real-time performance monitoring to detect any drop in production immediately.
We install solar on asphalt shingle, Spanish tile, standing seam metal, and flat roofs. We use flashing and waterproof penetrations backed by our 10-year roof-penetration warranty.

We offer $0-down solar loan options with terms ranging from 10 to 25 years, allowing you to swap your electric bill for a predictable solar payment that is often 20–40% lower than your current utility rate.

Adding a battery like the Tesla Powerwall 3 (13.5 kWh) or Enphase IQ 5P provides automatic backup power during grid blackouts in under 10 milliseconds, while storing excess daytime solar to power your home during expensive peak-rate evening hours.
